# Deepbionics — Extended Machine-Readable Overview

## Identity

Prof. Dr. Michael C. Thrun is Honorary Professor of Artificial Intelligence at Philipps-Universität Marburg, a researcher, university lecturer and managing director of IAP-GmbH. His profile combines decision support systems, explainable AI, machine learning, knowledge discovery and interdisciplinary data science.

## Research profile

The research focuses on identifying meaningful structures in complex and high-dimensional data and translating them into transparent, reproducible and practically useful support for human experts. Methods include interpretable and self-assessing models, human-in-the-loop analysis, clustering, visualization, classification, distribution analysis, time-series forecasting, swarm intelligence and self-organization.

## Interdisciplinary applications

Applications span medicine and life sciences, environmental science, archaeology, finance, supply-chain and industrial analytics. The project page documents decision-support systems, explainable biomedical AI, knowledge-discovery methods, forecasting, visualization, clustering and open research software.

## Software and teaching

The site provides open-source R packages for visualization, density analysis, clustering, dimensionality reduction, classification, forecasting and parallel computation. University teaching covers Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Knowledge Discovery and Temporal Data Mining, with reproducible R-based examples and critical evaluation of model assumptions and limitations.
